info.name: Student ID - Applicant Service
info.description: Owned broker migration candidate: public player requests use Gateway baseUrl; the owned internal folder uses private brokerBaseUrl with distinct Broker caller credentials. No Gateway/direct fallback. Run internal requests from the authorized container network; backend ports stay private. Current Credential/Session full-game acceptance and reviewed images remain required. 2026-11-12: these are the owned pre-migration Gateway checks. Record player reads authenticate the Gateway target credential before trusting identity headers; Postman must keep using Gateway with a real player JWT. Owned adapters now explicitly support Credential seed/status/callbacks. Actual current private Credential runtime acceptance remains required. Owned 1.0.0 HTTP integration source candidate. Supply separate caller and management credentials only in a private local environment. Public requests use Gateway baseUrl. Internal catalog operations require Gateway registry support and actual peer implementations; these checks do not certify whole-system readiness. Owned internal requests use Message Broker. Applicant merged Lab 3 source (0.4.0): run in order through Gateway http://localhost:8090 with a valid accessToken in a private local environment. Tracked tokens stay empty. Generates disposable student IDs, verifies CRUD, duplicate create/update 409 and rollback, sanitized 400/404 errors, 405 and cleanup. Record membership uses the configured real Gateway/Session integration; no runtime mock is supported. Internal /status, concurrent races, database faults, image provenance and full shared-stack acceptance are separate checks. Existing CPR image pins may predate these source changes.

item.name: Lab 4 Task 3 - Gateway boundary
item.description: Gateway public boundary checks. Keep baseUrl pointed at Gateway. The custom broker operational runtime does not yet transport these business calls.

request.description: Public Gateway relay for this service's existing health/readiness endpoint. Requires a running, healthy service and its database; this does not probe the custom broker.
Explicit No Auth overrides the collection bearer token. Gateway must reject this request before forwarding it to the owned service.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });

request.description: No Auth disables inherited authorization; the deliberately incomplete Bearer header contains no token. Gateway must return its existing 401 error.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });

pm.test('Created disposable record matches input', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i); pm.expect(body.studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('applicantId', body.id); });
pm.test('List includes created record: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Created ID is listed', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.some(row => row.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantId'))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Duplicate create is a conflict: HTTP 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test('Sanitized STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Create disposable conflict target: HTTP 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Created disposable record matches input', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i); pm.expect(body.studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantOtherStudentId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('applicantConflictId', body.id); });
pm.test('Duplicate update is a conflict: HTTP 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test('Sanitized STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Conflict rollback preserves target: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Conflicting update did not change student ID', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantOtherStudentId')));
pm.test('Invalid input is rejected: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Malformed JSON is rejected: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

pm.test('Sanitized INVALID_REQUEST error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });

pm.test('Sanitized APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Get deleted record returns 404: HTTP 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Sanitized APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });

item.name: Lab 4 Task 4 - Operational logs
item.description: Start the local log-download endpoint for the exact running Compose project. Set logDownloadUrl and a private logDownloadToken; this is a separate operations credential, not the collection's Player JWT. The download is limited to this owned service and its declared numeric replicas. To download the whole system, omit the service query on the same endpoint.

exec: pm.test('Exporter is UP', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('UP'); });

request.description: A finite text attachment from the selected Compose project. A 503 means the local Docker/configuration source is unavailable; it is not a successful empty log export.

exec: pm.test('Owned service snapshot includes the requested bounds', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.include('services=applicant-service'); pm.expect(text).to.include('since=15m; tail=200 per container'); });

pm.test('Operations authentication error is traceable', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHORIZED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Invalid query uses the operations contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('INVALID_LOG_QUERY'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); });
